title: Coordinate flip and noise distribution
statement: Let $m$ be a positive natural number, let $j\\in\\{1,\\ldots,m\\}$, and let $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}$. Choose $a$ uniformly from $\\{1,\\ldots,m\\}$ and output $-x$ if $a=j$, and $x$ otherwise. The resulting probability distribution is the coordinate noise distribution at $x$ with correlation parameter $1-2/m$.
